messages:
Tara: Quick thread — I'm starting a compact refresh of the 'Hello Grove Lite' quickstart. Goals: make env var names consistent, add a 1-file websocket echo example, and fix the broken anchor to /deploy/production#canary. Keeping changes small so internal links don't ripple.
Ben: Good. What's the canonical env var? REDWOOD_API_KEY still floating around in a few READMEs.
Tara: Proposal: RW_API_KEY as the canonical name. We'll add a short migration note and a tiny shim script `migrate-env.sh` for folks that still have REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Ivy: I ran the sample and hit a `401` because docker-compose mounts .env.example but the var name mismatch caused an empty header. I'll change the compose to reference RW_API_KEY and update samples/.env.example.
Ravi: CI runner used node 16 and the samples use fluent streams that need node 18+. I'll add engines: {"node": ">=18"} to samples/package.json and update the CI matrix to include node 18 only for sample smoke.
Olga: For the WS snippet, can we show both raw websocket and SDK async iterator? Suggest a tiny 12-line raw snippet and a 6-line SDK example. Keep auth header consistent.
Tara: Draft raw WS snippet to include in quickstart (short):
```js
// ws-echo.js
import WebSocket from 'ws';
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://realtime.redwood.ai/v1/echo', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` } });
ws.on('open', () => ws.send('hello'));
ws.on('message', m => console.log('echo:', m));
```
Olga: Nice and tiny. For the SDK async iterator example: 
```js
for await (const chunk of client.stream({ model: 'grove-lite', prompt: 'Hello' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```
Ben: Also add a Windows note for setting env vars before the docker compose step: `powershell: $env:RW_API_KEY='...'` — a few folks hit that.
Tara: Good call. I'll add a one-line note under "local dev". Also creating `scripts/migrate-env.sh` that sets RW_API_KEY from REDWOOD_API_KEY if present to ease upgrades.
Ivy: I pushed a branch `docs/hellogrove-lite-refresh` with the README and sample edits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8120. Please add review comments directly on the diff.
Ravi: Kicked off CI for the PR. DocsBot can you run the link-checker and a preview deploy? @DocsBot please run link-check + preview
DocsBot: Link check queued for PR #8120. Preview deploy requested.
Olga: I noticed a broken anchor in the TOC: /deploy/production#canary -> docs page uses #canary-deploys. I'll update the anchor to match.
DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #8120
Ben: CI smoke failed on the sample because the Dockerfile used `node:16-alpine`. I updated it to `node:18-alpine` in my branch and re-ran smoke.
Ivy: Thanks — I merged Ben's Dockerfile fix into the PR branch and re-ran tests.
Tara: Requested reviews from Ben/Ravi/Olga. Targeting merge tomorrow AM if CI is green. If someone can sanity-check the migrate-env script on mac/windows that'd help.
Ravi: I'll run windows/macos sanity tests in the morning on the lab machines.
Tara: Thanks all, will post merge + preview URL when it's live. :thumbsup:
